name: 🕴️ Facility Director
displayDescription:
One of the highest ranking staff members in the asylum. With this team you can:

- Command around the lower ranking staff 🫡
- Straitjacket patients that exhibit volatile behavior! ⛓️‍💥
- Get access to more areas of the asylum with your Facility Director Keycard 💳
- Highest position on the player list to show your power 💼
- Use the facility wide voice-chat intercom to issue asylum-wide announcements 📢
- Use a Remote Console to open doors remotely to cause some chaos 💥

⚠️ Only a limited amount of Facility Director game pass holders can be on the team in a server at any given time! If you are having trouble getting into a slot, try server hopping.

name: 🛡️ Elite Protection Unit
displayDescription:
The most dangerous & elite combat staff for the most violent patients. With this team you will:

- Get a special Electroshield to stun down multiple enemies at once ⚡
- Be able to order around other lower ranking guards 🫡
- Access more parts of the asylum with your Elite Protection Unit Keycard 💳
- Protect the facility directors if they are in danger 🛡️
- Get a tear gas canister to use in dire situations 💥

⚠️ Only a limited amount of EPU game pass holders can be on the team in a server at any given time! If you are having trouble getting into a slot, try server hopping.

name: VIP 👑
displayDescription: This game pass gives you access to the VIP cell in-game, a golden gradient leaderboard tag, access to premium daily login rewards, and per-team one-time use level rewards!

name: 💀 Metal Shard
displayDescription:
With this pass, you will spawn with the deadly Metal Shard.

This shard has the ability to poison those hit with it, on top of the already high damage of the glass shard!

name: Boombox 🎶
displayDescription:
Play your favorite tunes with this game pass! You spawn with a boom box that allows you to play a pre-selected list and a songs of your own choosing!

This tool is accessible via the roleplay items menu, which is on the right side of your heads up display!

Inappropriate audios will be met with moderation action!

name: Custom Clothing 👚
displayDescription:
This game pass lets you bypass the normal patient clothing for whatever clothing is on your avatar!

This game pass is made for use on the patient team.

Additionally will prevent Orderly riot uniform from being force equipped during events.

name: Orderly Riot Guard
displayDescription:
With this game pass, while on the Orderly team you will receive the best equipment from the facility's security armories! Adorned with riot armor, and equipment, you will gain a significant edge over the patients in their onslaught.

To toggle this, navigate to the settings menu under "Special". You can toggle it on and off there.

name: Custom Chat Colors 💬
displayDescription: Express yourself with this game pass! With it, you can access the settings menu and set your own colors and choose more fonts to communicate with in the game!

name: Molotov 🔥
displayDescription: This game pass gives you a permanent molotov every time you spawn. Throw the molotov and it creates entry denial with fire! (Burn damage continues even if people move away from the burning radius)

name: Stolen Keycard 🏃‍♂️
displayDescription:
This gives you permanent medical staff access to the asylum!

DISCLAIMER: This pass does not grant access to any of the elevators within the game.

name: Protest Sign
displayDescription:
Express yourself with this game pass! Put text on a protest sign you spawn with.

Inappropriate text will be met with moderation action! ⚠️

name: Permanent Crowbar
displayDescription: This game pass gives you a crowbar that can be used to move throughout the vents of the asylum on spawn! This item also doubles down as a melee weapon.

name: Custom Night Vision Color
displayDescription: Set your own night vision color!

name: Permanent Glass Shard
displayDescription: This game pass gives you a glass shard that does a lot of damage permanently!

name: Nightvision
displayDescription:
This piece of equipment was directly sourced from the armories Stone-Haven combative departments have access to. Wearing these goggles, and pressing the "N" key will toggle your ability to see in the dark.

This game pass is intended for use on the patient team.

name: Gasmask
displayDescription: This handy gas mask will protect you from the effects of gas grenades, and pepper spray!

name: Spraypaint 🎨
displayDescription:
Express your creativity with the new Stone-Haven Spraypaint Can ✨

🎨 Crafted among patients to express their creative power, this can allows you to spray down a max of 3 images of your choosing at any time!

⚠️ Inappropriate images will be met with moderation action!
